mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, increasing corporate earnings visibility and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through higher equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth rate above 2.0% fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances with Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points in one month signals imminent monetary tightening, compressing equity risk premiums and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increases > 0.3pp in 1 month correlate with positive 5-day returns in > 40% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to predict positive 60-day returns in > 50% of cases with Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 92.0 (index) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate capital expenditure and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 92.0 in late-cycle expansions fails to produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) above 550.0 thousand units indicates strong residential investment, increasing consumer wealth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 550.0 fails to predict positive 5-day returns in > 50% of instances with Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive Fed policy responses that depress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% correlates with positive 60-day returns in > 40% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint UNRATE decline and RSAFS increase fails to predict positive 20-day returns in > 50% of cases with Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns, industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index) signals output contraction, reducing corporate capacity utilization and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 90.0 in manufacturing slowdowns fails to produce negative 5-day returns in > 60% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
